annotations.title: Place a limit or stop order

description: Place a resting order that fills only when the market reaches your price, and fills AT that price. type "limit" = a pullback entry (long below the market, short above); type "stop" = a breakout entry (long above the market, short below). To open right now use paper_open instead. Simulated money only. Requires an API key.

limit_price.description: Below the market for a long, above it for a short
